samples.analysis:
A Google Chrome Incognito window is open to the YOLOKFX website, with the tab/page title “How to Get Free SHEIN Products.”

- A black site header shows the **YOLOKFX** logo and navigation links: **HOME, FASHION, TRENDS, CONTACT**, plus a search icon.
- The main article heading reads **“How to Get Free SHEIN Products”**, followed by: “Discover how the official SHEIN reviewer program works and learn how to apply for product testing opportunities.”
- Near the top is a prompt, **“One last question and we will show you how!”**, asking how the user prefers to receive items. It has two green buttons: **Store pickup** and **Home delivery**.
- To the right is a location/age panel headed **“Lake Worth, FL Drivers:”** and **“TAP YOUR AGE:”**, with blue buttons for **18–24, 25–34, 35–44, 45–64, 65–74,** and **75+**.
- Below is a large **SHEIN** logo with an **“OFFICIAL REVIEWER PROGRAM”** badge.
- Visible article text explains that SHEIN offers an official product-testing program, says selection is **never guaranteed**, and discusses reviewing clothing, shoes, accessories, and other products.
- A prominent section titled **“🔥 THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP BEFORE APPLYING”** advises keeping profile, sizing, shipping address, and purchase history accurate, and applying only through the **official SHEIN website or mobile app**.
- The next heading, **“How the Official SHEIN Reviewer…”**, is partially visible at the bottom.
